core\utils\canvas\widgets\burger-button-webgl.ts

WebGL menu icon for the nav burger button: four rounded
Sourcesrc/core\utils\canvas\widgets\burger-button-webgl.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

SUPERSAMPLE

Backing-store supersample factor on top of the capped DPR — a 34px icon renders at ~136–272 buffer px so the CSS downsample adds a second AA pass. The shader divides by it to recover the "close px" basis the shared close-paint library is authored in.

LIQUID_RATE_PER_S

Liquid pour speed, per second — matches CloseButtonWebGL's 1.6%/frame at 60fps so the open-state water fill pours at the same rate every close button does (~1s to fill on hover, same on drain).

ROT_RATE_PER_S

X-spin speed, per second — matches CloseButtonWebGL's 4%/frame at 60fps so the half-turn lands near the end of the pour.

CLICK_TIME_OFF

Timestamp that disables the click shockwave (far past sentinel).

BurgerButtonWebGL

WebGL liquid menu icon for the burger button. Renders four rounded squares that drift with a liquid idle, pool toward the center on hover/focus, and morph into the close X when the menu opens (setOpen). Adapts to the current theme: dark icon in light mode, bright icon in dark mode.

canvas

  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas - icon canvas inside the nav burger button
  • @param {Function} onClick - optional click handler (the canvas becomes

_hover

Smoothed hover convergence — pointer enter/leave + focus/blur drive the target.

_open

Smoothed menu-open morph — setOpen drives the target.

_liquid

Close-state liquid pour (u_liquid) — the turquoise water fill every close button shows on hover. Target follows hover ONLY while the menu is open, so the fill never pre-charges behind the closed icon.

_rot

Close-state X rotation (u_rot) — the half-turn the real close button's X performs while its liquid fills on hover.

_clickT

Seconds since startTime of the last press — drives the click shockwave.

_prevT

Previous frame's t — the approach easings consume dt, not absolutes.

_initGL

Creates the WebGL context + shader program; falls back to the CSS/DOM path on failure.

_initGLReal

The synchronous WebGL bootstrap — context, program, quad, uniform handles.

_triggerFallback

Switches to the non-WebGL path (CSS class on the host / Canvas2D) — used on context loss or init failure.

_checkResize

Re-syncs the drawing buffer to the canvas's CSS box × devicePixelRatio (capped at 2). Only reallocates when the rounded size actually changed, and repaints one frame immediately when the RAF loop isn't running — in reduced-motion static mode a resize would otherwise leave the cleared buffer blank until the next state change.

setOpen

Menu-open driver — the nav calls this on toggle/close so the pooled droplet morphs into the close X (and back). With no running loop (reduced motion, pre-start) the state snaps and repaints once.

  • @param open Whether the menu overlay is open.

_setHover

Hover-convergence driver — pointer enter/leave and focus/blur feed it.

_settleNow

Snaps the smoothed state to its targets and repaints — the static path.

_start

Chooses reduced-motion static render vs the rAF loop.

_drawFrame

Renders one frame at time t (seconds) — shared by the RAF loop and the static reduced-motion path. u_dark is re-evaluated per frame from the live DOM classes (dark theme OR nav-on-dark over the contact band) so the icon recolors instantly on theme/scroll changes with no listener.

  • @param {number} t - seconds since construction

_loop

rAF callback — repaints each frame while running.

purge

webglPool hook — offscreen: stops the loop and releases the GL context entirely; restore() rebuilds it on re-entry so offscreen widgets never hold context slots.

restore

Recreates the GL context and resumes the loop after an offscreen purge.

destroy

Releases the context, buffers, listeners and rAF handle so the canvas can be GC'd.
